{{Quote|Truly it is a dark time for the galaxy. All we can do is give our best and do what we can to preserve the New Republic. Of course, it isn't as bad as Tarim or Bahni make out.|Arhul Hextrophon in a personal message to [[Voren Na'al/Legends|Voren Na'al]]|<ref name="RJ">{{WEGCite|story=A Rebel's Job is Never Done ...|book=Dark Empire Sourcebook}}</ref>}}
'''Bahni''' was an associate of [[Arhul Hextrophon/Legends|Arhul Hextrophon]] who believed the [[Second Battle of Coruscant|loss of Coruscant]] in [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]] was a shattering blow to the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Hextrophon did not believe that the situation was a dire as Bahni believed.<ref name="RJ" />
